description: The plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models: “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as described in the paper “SepLLM: Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into One Separator.” The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is also linear, spanning from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks every 0.05 units. The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 2.75 loss at 0 seconds and gradually decreasing to about 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The “SepLLM” model is shown with a red line and circular markers, beginning at roughly 2.72 loss and declining more steeply to approximately 2.48 by 250,000 seconds. A green dashed horizontal line at loss ≈ 2.50 marks a reference level, and a green vertical dashed line at 200,000 seconds intersects both curves, with a label “1.26×” indicating that SepLLM reaches the same loss level as Vanilla at 1.26 times faster training time. The gridlines aid in visual alignment of values across the plot.
